# laminar_signal (Data Source)

Read an existing Laminar Signal by UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "laminar_signal" "existing" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

output "signal_name" {
  value = data.laminar_signal.existing.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Signal UUID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `current_version` (Number)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `filters` (String)
- `mode` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `project_id` (String)
- `prompt` (String)
- `sample_rate` (Number)
- `structured_output` (String)
- `trigger` (String)
